name: 男の子（基本・持ち歩き）
prompt: Carry-walk pose variant of avatar.boy-basic, v3 — the bent-elbow respec (owner directions 2026-08-09: ①an item carrier bends the elbow, standing AND walking ②the mitten hand renders IN FRONT of the held item, MapleStory's hand-over-item layering — hence the handLayer cut below). Stage 0: the bent-arm STAND was made by a nano-banana-2 single-frame edit of the base stand ('bend his near arm at the elbow ~90°, forearm horizontal in front of his belly, palm up as if about to carry a small tray; everything else identical'), then cleaned through the standard post-composition (chroma flatten, key, scale to the base stand height, base stand's head composited at the neck pinch — the edit drifts face/hair, the head composite makes it pixel-identical again). Stage 1: that clean bent stand on a 720x720 pure #00FF00 canvas (feet y=640). Stage 2: alibaba/wan-2.7-i2v ($0.50, first try obeyed): 'The chibi boy game character from the image walks in place, treadmill-style, without moving across the frame. An exaggerated cartoon game walk cycle like classic 2D side-scrolling games: BIG strides with legs swinging far forward and far back, knees lifting high on each step. IMPORTANT: his near arm stays PERFECTLY STILL exactly as in the image - bent at the elbow, forearm horizontal in front of his belly, open hand palm-up as if carrying a small tray; that arm and hand do not swing, do not move, do not change shape at all. His far arm also stays still, hanging at his side. Only his legs move. Legs strictly alternate: right leg steps forward, then left leg steps forward. He keeps facing right in 3/4 view. The camera is completely static, no zoom, no pan. The flat pure green #00FF00 chroma-key background stays perfectly unchanged and empty. The character stays centered with his feet returning to the same ground line every step. Constant even lighting, no shadows.' Committed cells: the bent stand plus video frames n66 (contact) / n71 (passing) / n75 (opposite contact) / n80 (opposite passing), each center-cropped 760px, downscaled 2x, shadowed-green flattened, base head composited at each frame's own neck anchor. handAnchors = the palm's top-center per frame (the item rest point; the still arm keeps it within ±1px across the stride). handLayer: true cuts the bare hand+forearm (skin blob at the stand hand anchor + its outline ring) as hand.png, rendered ON TOP of the held item so the hand reads as in front (its grip aligns to each pose's hand anchor).
